[DESIGN]
# 캘린더 — Design

## Purpose

Put events in, see them at a glance on a month calendar, delete the ones no
longer needed, and get a reminder 10 minutes before each event starts.

## Reuse

- Reminders: the 알림 app (`app_0000000000000000000000ntfy`, domain `notify`)
  has the public tool `notify.schedule({title, at})`. The calendar calls it
  when an event is added, declared in `app_connections`. Calendar does not
  keep its own reminder engine.
  - Known limits of 알림 (read from its source, not ours to change): it only
    stores the reminder and does not pop it up at the time itself; it has no
    tool to cancel a reminder, so deleting an event cannot remove its reminder.
- `@me/date-range@1.0.0`: checked. It helps with week ranges and local strings;
  the calendar needs month grids and the tools take epoch milliseconds, so it
  is not used.
- UI: `@lophn/ui` (AppShell, Card, Button, IconButton, Dialog, Field, Input,
  Textarea, ReadState, EmptyState, List/ListItem, Tooltip, ToastProvider) and
  `@lophn/app-ui` (useTool, AppErrorBoundary).

## Model

Stored (app DB, table `event`):

| column             | meaning                                                   |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| id                 | integer primary key                                       |
| title              | 1–200 chars, trimmed                                      |
| start_at           | start, epoch ms                                           |
| end_at             | end, epoch ms, nullable, `>= start_at`                    |
| note               | optional, up to 2000 chars                                |
| reminder_status    | `scheduled`, `too_late`, `failed`, `unknown`              |
| reminder_id        | id the 알림 app returned, nullable                        |
| created_at         | ISO time                                                  |

Rule: the reminder time is always `start_at - 10 minutes` (person's choice).
If that time is already past when the event is added, no reminder is asked
for (`too_late`).

Computed when shown: month grid (6 weeks starting Monday), events per day,
local times, "upcoming" list for the card.

## Journeys

1. First visit: the month calendar of today, today selected, the day list
   says "No events on this day." with [New event].
2. Add: [New event] → dialog (title, date, start time, end time optional,
   note optional) → [Save]. The event appears on its day; a bell mark shows
   the reminder was set; a toast says "Event added. Reminder set for 10
   minutes before." or tells that the reminder could not be set.
3. See: move months with ‹ › and [Today]; click a day to list its events in
   time order.
4. Delete: trash button on an event in the day list → the event is gone and a
   toast says so.

## Screens

One screen `home`, sizes full, panel, card.

- Header (AppShell): title "Calendar"; action [New event] (primary).
- Full: left the month grid (month label, ‹ [Today] ›, 7 weekday heads, 42
  day cells with up to 3 event titles and "+N more"; today and the selected
  day marked); right the selected day panel (date heading, List of events:
  time range, title, bell or bell-off mark, trash IconButton).
- Panel: the grid shows only a dot count per day; the day list goes below.
- Card: upcoming events (next 30 days, first 5) as a List; empty: "No
  upcoming events." with [New event].
- Add: Dialog with Field/Input/Textarea; field errors in place (title empty,
  end before start). Save button busy while saving.
- Remove: trash IconButton per event, no extra confirm (lophn records and can
  undo writes).
- Empty: EmptyState in the day list. Loading and error: ReadState around the
  month data (ErrorState with [Reload]).

## Tools

All private (`public: false`), domain `calendar`.

| name              | effect | input                                   | output                          |
| ----------------- | ------ | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `calendar.list`   | read   | `{from, to}` epoch ms, `from < to`, span ≤ 400 days | read result rows of events overlapping `[from, to)`, by start |
| `calendar.add`    | write  | `{title, start, end?, note?}`           | the saved event with `reminder_status` |
| `calendar.remove` | write  | `{id}`                                  | `{id, removed: true}`           |

Rules: title trimmed, 1–200; end ≥ start; `calendar.add` stores the event,
then calls `notify.schedule({title, at: start - 10 min})` unless too late, then
stores the reminder status. A failed reminder never undoes the event.

## Failure branches

| name                     | when                                         | result                         |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `store_unavailable`      | DB cannot be opened/migrated                 | rejection `unavailable`        |
| `event_input_invalid`    | blank title, end before start, bad range     | rejection `invalid_input`      |
| `event_not_found`        | remove of an id that does not exist          | rejection `conflict`           |
| `reminder_call_failed`   | the call to 알림 could not be made           | event kept, status `failed`    |
| `reminder_denied`        | lophn did not let the call through           | event kept, status `failed`    |
| `reminder_target_failed` | 알림 answered with an error                  | event kept, status `failed`    |
| `reminder_outcome_unknown` | no answer whether 알림 saved it            | event kept, status `unknown`   |
| `reminder_too_late`      | (not a problem, no log) start within 10 min  | status `too_late`              |
| `reminder_not_cancelled` | event removed that had a reminder (알림 has no cancel tool) | logged, removal goes on |

[HUMAN_REQUEST]
캘린더 앱 하나 만들어 줘. 일정을 넣어 두고, 한눈에 보고, 필요 없으면 지울 수 있었으면 좋겠어. 일정 시작하기 전에 알려 주기도 하고.

[QUESTIONS]
Q1: 일정을 한눈에 볼 때 어떤 모양이 좋으세요?
- 월 달력 + 날짜별 목록 (추천): 한 달을 칸으로 보고, 날짜를 누르면 그날 일정이 옆/아래 목록으로 보입니다. 구글·애플 캘린더 기본 모양.
- 주간 목록: 이번 주·다음 주 일정을 날짜순 목록으로 봅니다. 단순하지만 한 달은 한 번에 못 봅니다.
- 다가오는 일정 목록만: 오늘 이후 일정을 시간순으로 나열합니다. 가장 단순합니다.
Q2: 일정 시작 전 언제 알려 드릴까요?
- 일정마다 고르기 (추천): 넣을 때 '알림 없음 / 10분 / 30분 / 1시간 / 하루 전' 중 고릅니다. 기본값은 10분 전.
- 항상 10분 전: 고르는 칸 없이 모든 일정에 10분 전 알림이 붙습니다.
- 항상 1시간 전: 고르는 칸 없이 모든 일정에 1시간 전 알림이 붙습니다.
